authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong structural integrity and lighting coherence. However, two specific artifacts prevent a perfect authenticity score: 1) The shell surfaces exhibit a uniform, plastic-like sheen lacking the micro-texture variation of real keratin (severity ~1.5). 2) There is slight ambiguity at the foot-ground contact points where toes appear to merge slightly with the leaf litter rather than resting distinctly on top (severity ~2.0). These are characteristic AI generation flaws in monochromatic organic rendering and ground interaction.
key_defects: Shell texture appears overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking natural keratin micro-details.
Slight fusion/merging of foot digits with the ground/leaf litter at contact points.
